entries.requirement: Current committed MVP branch code has been deployed through the approved GitHub Actions path, or deployment is explicitly declared out of scope by the user.
entries.evidence: Round 60 through Round 82 proved several deployment subpaths but not a complete current-branch deployment: earlier push/manual runs reached backend/admin image builds, ECS checkout or artifact download/load, and in run 26803892859 ECS-2 successfully downloaded/extracted/synced the deployment bundle artifact plus downloaded/loaded the backend image artifact. That run then failed production Deploy backend host locally with sanitized validation error WECHAT_PAY_MCH_ID is required, so the backend container was not recreated and post-deploy smoke did not run. Round 83 committed/pushed b10bb7e and triggered backend-only deployment_lane=nonprod-mock-payment workflow run 26804961943. detect-targets and package-deploy-bundle passed, build-admin-web was skipped as expected, but build-backend failed before ECS deploy because Docker Buildx on the GitHub hosted runner timed out pulling moby/buildkit:buildx-stable-1 from Docker Hub registry-1.docker.io. Backend image build, ECS deploy, and smoke did not run. Current-branch deployment remains unproven. If GitHub-to-ECS artifact/API downloads or GitHub-hosted external registry access remain unstable, the documented no-new-paid-service fallback is to move release images/artifacts to Alibaba Cloud-side free resources such as Alibaba Cloud Container Registry Personal Edition or an ECS-local signed artifact directory, then have ECS pull/load and deploy locally.
entries.nextAction: Decide the next deployment lane. For production-like evidence, provision real ECS-2 WeChat Pay variables/key files and rerun production deploy. For reduced-scope evidence, rerun deployment_lane=nonprod-mock-payment after build-path stability is addressed or treated as transient.
